headerDisplay:
### Getting Started

1. **Create API Token**: Visit the [SleepMe Developer Portal](https://docs.developer.sleep.me/docs/) to create your API token
2. **Add Token Below**: Paste your API token in the API Tokens field
3. **Save & Restart**: Save configuration and restart Homebridge

api_keys.title: API Tokens
api_keys.description: SleepMe API tokens for authentication. Get your token at https://docs.developer.sleep.me/docs/

device_ids.title: Device ID Allowlist
device_ids.description: Optional. Leave empty to add every Dock Pro on your account. If you list any device IDs here, ONLY those devices are added. Device IDs appear in the Homebridge log as 'Adding new accessory' entries.

supported_models.title: Supported Models
supported_models.description: Optional escape hatch. Defaults to DP999NA (Dock Pro). Devices reporting any other model are skipped, so newer SleepMe products (such as the ST501NA Sleep Tracker) are not added as thermostats that never update. If SleepMe ships a new Dock Pro with a different model code, add it here.

water_level_type.title: Water Level Alert Type

oneOf.title: Battery (Recommended)
oneOf.description: Shows water level as battery percentage in Home app

oneOf.title: Leak Sensor
oneOf.description: Shows as leak sensor - triggers 'leak detected' when water is low

oneOf.title: Motion Sensor
oneOf.description: Shows as motion sensor - triggers 'motion detected' when water is low

water_level_type.description: Choose how low water level alerts appear in HomeKit. Battery shows water %, leak/motion sensors are useful for automations.

base_polling_interval_seconds.title: Base Polling Interval (Seconds)
base_polling_interval_seconds.description: Each device is polled every X seconds multiplied by the number of devices sharing your API token, so two docks at the default of 10 are each polled every 20 seconds. Total API usage stays the same however many docks you own. The SleepMe API allows only 10 requests per minute per account and the default spends exactly the share of that reserved for polling, so the only reason to change this is to use less: doubling it to 20 halves the plugin's API traffic.

standby_polling_interval_minutes.title: Standby Polling Interval (Minutes)
standby_polling_interval_minutes.description: How often to check device status when in standby/off. Not scaled by device count — even four devices at the 15 minute default cost well under one request per minute. Recommended: leave at 15 minutes.

layout.title: API Tokens
layout.description: Add one or more SleepMe API tokens. Multiple tokens allow you to control devices from different SleepMe accounts.

items.title: Device ID Allowlist
items.description: Leave empty to add every Dock Pro on your account. Add IDs to restrict the plugin to specific devices.

items.title: Supported Models
items.description: Leave empty to use the default (DP999NA). Only change this if SleepMe ships a Dock Pro with a new model code.

items.title: Water Level Alert Type
items.description: Use 'Battery' for most users. Use 'Leak Sensor' if you want HomeKit automations triggered by low water.

items.helpvalue:
Polling Intervals

These are optimized automatically — most users should not change them.

items.title: Base Polling Interval (Seconds)
items.description: Seconds between polls of each device while it is ON, multiplied by the number of devices sharing your API token. Two docks at the default are each polled every 20 seconds. Default: 10 seconds.

items.title: Standby Polling Interval (Minutes)
items.description: Minutes between polls of each device while it is OFF. Not multiplied by device count. Default: 15 minutes.
